DVCS Quick Guide

This page briefly introduces DVCS_xsec module for deeply virtual Compton scattering (DVCS) cross-section calculations. The formalism follows Guo et al. (2022).

The implementation is generated from the Mathematica master expressions and numerically cross-checked.

DVCS Main Callables

The module provides three core differential cross-sections:

  • DVCS_xsec.dsigma_BH() for the Bethe-Heitler (BH) contribution.

  • DVCS_xsec.dsigma_DVCS() for the pure DVCS contribution.

  • DVCS_xsec.dsigma_INT() for the BH-DVCS interference contribution.

Helpers:

  • DVCS_xsec.dsigma_DVCS_TOT() for \(d\sigma_{\mathrm{BH}} + d\sigma_{\mathrm{DVCS}} + d\sigma_{\mathrm{INT}}\).

  • DVCS_xsec.Asymmetry_DVCS_TOT() for spin asymmetries, \(A = d\sigma(\mathrm{pol}) / d\sigma(\mathrm{UU})\).

  • DVCS_xsec.dsigma_DVCS_HERA() for the virtual-photon-proton cross-section integrated over \(\phi\) (HERA convention).

DVCS Common Inputs

The differential functions use the following common inputs:

  • y (float): beam energy-loss variable.

  • xB (float): Bjorken \(x_B\).

  • t (float): momentum transfer squared.

  • Q (float): photon virtuality.

  • phi (float): azimuthal angle.

  • pol (str): polarization configuration label.

  • HCFF (complex): Compton form factor \(H\).

  • ECFF (complex): Compton form factor \(E\).

  • HtCFF (complex): Compton form factor \(\widetilde{H}\).

  • EtCFF (complex): Compton form factor \(\widetilde{E}\).

Polarization Convention

The polarization label uses beam-target form \(P_B P_T\), where \(P_B \in \{U, L\}\) and \(P_T \in \{U, L, T_{\mathrm{in}}, T_{\mathrm{out}}\}\).

Supported labels are:

  • UU

  • LU

  • UL

  • LL

  • UTin

  • LTin

  • UTout

  • LTout

Example: pol = 'UTout'.

HERA Observable

DVCS_xsec.dsigma_DVCS_HERA() integrates over \(\phi\), so phi is not an input argument for this function.
